jobs.title: IT Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
An electric utility client is looking for an IT Senior Project Manager 
who will lead all phases of the project lifecycle and system integrator engagement activities, including pre-planning, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for a major Advanced Metering Infrastructure initiative. 

Position:
 IT Senior Project Manager
Location: 
Rosemead, CA 91770 - Hybrid Onsite Tues & Wed
Pay Rate
: $102.56/hr. on W2
Duration
: 12 months or longer
Schedule: 
1st shift, M-F, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

The IT Senior Project Manager for the AMI 2.0 Program will lead all phases of the project lifecycle and system integrator engagement activities, including pre-planning, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for a major Advanced Metering Infrastructure initiative. This role focuses on resource and task planning, technical blueprinting, business process design, and vendor coordination within a complex IT environment. Facilitate IT business process mapping and requirements clarification to ensure alignment with functional needs, technical delivery, and IT SI area of responsibility.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Prepare, analyze, manage and deliver regular financial reports, tracking TI expenditures for the AMI 2.0 program releases including variances and forecasts; collaborating closely with TI management and technical teams.
Develop a comprehensive resource plan based on technical scope, including roles, skillsets, and effort and cost estimates across workstreams (integration, data, infrastructure, and testing).
Support the development and refinement of a high-level solution blueprint that defines scope, schedule, and budget from a technical lens — integrating infrastructure, data flows, and system interfaces to inform delivery planning.
Plan and coordinate the Planning & Analyze phases, including solution design validation, technical feasibility reviews, and preparation for Build phase activities including, e.g., environment readiness, development sequencing, testing strategy, and deployment rollout.
Coordinate project activities across technical and business teams to ensure alignment with milestones and deliverables, i.e., solution analysis and design deliverables align with functional needs and technical delivery.
Track scope against baseline requirements and support change control process; document scope changes, assess impacts, and escalate risks to senior leadership as needed ensuring traceability between requirements, design, and deliverables.
Maintain clear documentation of financial transactions and project milestones for audit and compliance purposes.
Identifying risks, opportunities, and recommending corrective actions as needed.
Support procurement, vendor management, and contract negotiations related to TI and financial components of the project.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Technology, or related field.
Broad IT infrastructure knowledge — ability to see the “big picture” and ensure no gaps in delivery.
Experience managing large IT programs, resource planning, solution blueprinting, implementation planning, and overall end-to-end delivery management.
3+ years of experience in Large-scale IT program/project management in utilities or regulated industries.
Experience with AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure), smart grid, or large Electric Utility technology and infrastructure projects: AMI 1.0 or 2.0 preferred (at minimum some 1.0 exposure).
Demonstrates strong communication, problem-solving, management of risks/issues, and cross-functional leadership engagement.
Ability to quickly integrate into a fast-paced, large program, understand their role, absorb information rapidly, and deliver results efficiently with appropriate level of direction and guidance.
Strong blend of business insight and technical proficiency to bridge the gap between stakeholder needs and technological solutions.
Ability to personally execute day-to-day PM deliverables, in addition to overseeing and delegation. Must be adaptable, open to feedback, and able to take on other responsibilities as assigned

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience delivering/developing technical information to a non-technical audience.
PMP certification.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and financial compliance in utility or IT sectors.
Strong track record in vendor management and IT contract negotiations.

About our client
:
Our client is one of the largest electric utilities and a longtime leader in renewable energy and energy efficiency in the United States providing electricity for much of Southern California.

About APR:

Since 1980 APR Consulting, Inc. has provided professional recruiting and contingent workforce solutions to a diverse mix of clients, industries, and skill sets nationwide.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Role Title:
Program Manager, U.S. Army - Flight School Next

Location:
Robinson Helicopter Company Headquarters, Torrance, California.

Reporting To:
VP, Business Development

Travel:
Up to 33% as required

Range:
$130,000-$150,000 (Dependent on Experience and Qualifications)

Position Summary

The Program Manager serves as the overall program lead for Robinson Helicopter Company’s (RHC) execution of the U.S. Army Flight School Next (FSN) program. Based at RHC Headquarters in Torrance, California, this role owns cost, schedule, and performance across the program and serves as the central point of coordination between RHC engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, customer success, and the Flight School Next field team at Fort Rucker, Alabama.

The ideal candidate possesses strong program management discipline, defense contracting experience, and the leadership presence to represent RHC to Army stakeholders, the contracting prime, and internal executive leadership while driving on-time, on-budget delivery of a mission-critical training fleet and sustainment program.

Essential Job Functions

Program Leadership & Execution

Own overall cost, schedule, and technical performance for the RHC Flight School Next program.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule, program plans, and performance baselines.
Lead program reviews, milestone gates, and executive status briefings.
Manage program risk, opportunity, and corrective action planning to ensure mission success.

Contract & Financial Management

Manage program budget, financial forecasting, and earned value against the approved baseline.
Ensure compliance with contract requirements, deliverables, and applicable federal regulations.
Coordinate contract modifications, renewals, and option-year exercises with the contracting prime.
Oversee subcontract and supplier performance in support of program objectives.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

Serve as the RHC primary program point of contact for the contracting prime and Army stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with the Business Development Director and Flight School Site Manager on field execution.
Represent the program to RHC executive leadership and the Vice President of Business Development.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with military, government, and contractor partners.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Direct and integrate RHC engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and customer success teams.
Ensure field, technical, and account support resources are aligned to program requirements.
Drive process improvements that reduce cost of operation and improve customer satisfaction.
Support deployment, fielding, and sustainment activities across all Flight School Next locations.

Documentation & Reporting

Prepare program status reports, executive briefings, and performance dashboards.
Maintain program documentation, records, and configuration management compliance.
Track, monitor, and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) established by RHC.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, program management, or related field.
10+ years of program or project management experience, including defense or aerospace programs.
Demonstrated experience managing cost, schedule, and performance on government or DoD contracts.
PMP certification or equivalent program management credential preferred.
Experience with Robinson helicopters or rotary-wing platforms preferred.
Strong leadership, organization, and risk management skills.
Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, ERP Software (e.g. Epicor, SAP, or like software) and Atlassian Jira (or like software).
Ability to work independently and lead within a cross-functional team environment.
Must be able to work onsite at Torrance, California, including hangar and flight line environments at headquarters and Fort Rucker, Alabama. Work hours are assigned by business needs Monday through Friday; occasional weekend work may be required based on operational demand.
U.S. Citizenship required.
Possess current passport.

Collaborating cross-functionally internally and externally to understand partner capabilities, build a bridge to NVIDIA reference architectures and drive execution
Identifying and driving opportunities to onboard the adoption of third-party and in-house solutions for deployments, support, security, compliance and observability across DGX Cloud
Establishing metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) and quantitatively demonstrating the value and impact delivered by your programs.
Proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks and issues that could affect scope, schedule, and quality across all program aspects.
Developing and executing a robust communication strategy to ensure organizational visibility on overall program progress and engineering delivery, including presenting regularly to NVIDIA's executive leadership team.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Advisory
jobs.description:
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources, and task management. You will communicate transparently and in a timely manner with assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders, managing project risks and ensuring timely resolution while reporting status with appropriate internal and external stakeholders. This role requires an effective leader who excels in problem-solving, can motivate a result-oriented team, and builds trust-based relationships with Signant Health clients. You will contribute to the implementation of company-wide process improvements to ensure effective and efficient project delivery.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

Manage and lead initial project delivery tasks, including the software development lifecycle (SDLC) of simple to medium complexity studies.
Ensure project systems are built and released in accordance with client expectations; lead the project system change control process.
Support implementation of complex, multi-product projects as needed.
Manage projects in accordance with established timelines, budgets, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
Review, approve, and maintain project and corporate systems and documentation.
Handle client escalations independently; work with internal and client teams to resolve issues and escalate as appropriate in a timely manner.
Serve as the primary contact for customers on assigned projects; ensure quality of communication with clients in terms of cadence, content, and audience.
Manage financial health of assigned projects, including vendor services, licensing, payments, invoicing, devices, resource assignments, and vendor management activities.
Collaborate with other functional areas to ensure project delivery meets timelines and client expectations within budget.
Identify and document Incident Reports with Quality Management; coordinate client notification and closure.
Report project status updates to internal and external stakeholders.

DECISION MAKING AND INFLUENCE

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence.
Capable of weighing risks and making decisions that align with Signant values and strategy.
Manage customer escalations effectively, with follow-up and closure.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
Proven experience in a Project Management role or equivalent
Understanding of the software development life cycle and specification and configuration of software products
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with excellent time management, communication (oral and written), and organizational skills
Detail-oriented with focus on first-time quality delivery
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint)
Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization; comfortable presenting to diverse and large audiences
Proven ability to direct project activities, ensure customer satisfaction, and adhere to study budgets
Must show initiative and be able to work independently as needed

Desirable:

Background in pharmaceutical, medical device, medical education, or CRO industries
Experience with clinical trials, pharmaceutical industry, or life sciences
Knowledge of the clinical research environment and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Willingness to travel for business (overnight trips expected quarterly)

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead high-value and integration projects for our hospital customers. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on technical work and strategic project management: you'll be the primary point of contact for customers, own the data integration and infrastructure work that gets them live, and coordinate internal technical and business teams to deliver a seamless experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical aptitude (scripting, data validation, healthcare systems integration) with the polish and judgment needed to manage relationships with clinicians, IT leaders, and executive stakeholders. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, translating between technical and non-technical audiences, and driving projects to completion under pressure.

Representative Duties & Responsibilities

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, forming trusted relationships with clinicians, IT stakeholders, and executive sponsors
Own and manage complex, technical implementation and integration projects from kickoff through go-live, coordinating internal technical resources and
external customer technical teams
Consult with customer technical teams on how to properly extract, transform, and load data (EMR, ADC, and other source systems) into the Bluesight platform
Validate, reconcile, and analyze data from disparate systems using command-line tools and scripts to ensure data integrity
Act as an escalation point for issues that go beyond basic support, requiring longer-term coordination of technical resources across teams
Set clear, realistic expectations with clients, manage timelines and risk, and ensure consistent follow-through
Provide regular updates to management and executive stakeholders on project status, milestones, and results
Produce technical procedures, integration documentation, and best-practice guides for new and existing applications
Collaborate cross-functionally with Implementation, Product, and Engineering to improve processes, enhance data pipelines, and inform the product roadmap with customer feedback

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
4+ years of professional experience in a client-facing role, including direct customer support or project management
2-4+ years of project management experience managing technical projects
Experience with relational or non-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, MS-SQL, Oracle, MongoDB)
Ability to build trusting, communicative, and results-oriented relationships with customer stakeholders
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Advanced Excel skills for large data sets, including pivot tables
Ability to adapt to change, think quickly, work independently, and manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines
High attention to detail and strong problem-solving/troubleshooting skills
Willingness to travel up to 10%

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

Experience in the healthcare industry, especially with hospital EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, MEDITECH) or ADC systems (e.g., Omnicell, Pyxis)
Experience with AWS services (e.g., AWS Glue, Step Functions, Lambda) or other cloud data infrastructure
Experience coding in Python, Ruby, or another scripting language
Experience working with PHI and familiarity with HIPAA requirements
Prior experience on an Operations or Implementation team, especially deploying
SaaS products in client environments
Track record managing relationships with large, complex, or strategically important customer accounts

This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.

Why Bluesight?

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!

Competitive salary
Time off when you need it - unlimited vacation days!
Generous insurance coverage
401k program with a company match
Fun, collaborative culture!

jobs.description:
About the Company:

Our client sells playground equipment and offers installation services for customers who want them. They are a small business that is continuously evolving and improving processes.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an Installation Coordinator, also known as an Operations Coordinator, to manage their installation jobs. This role involves overseeing 50-100 open installation jobs at any given time. The coordinator will act as the primary point of contact between customers and installers, ensuring customers are informed about the process and installers have the necessary resources. This is a customer-facing role that requires strong problem-solving skills, as it involves managing construction-related projects and addressing unique challenges that arise on each job site.
The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver, comfortable communicating with customers and installers to find solutions. This role is crucial in ensuring a smooth and positive installation experience for all parties involved.

Responsibilities of the role:

• Manage 50-100 open installation jobs.
• Communicate with customers to educate them on the installation process.
• Coordinate with installers to ensure they are organized and have everything they need.
• Schedule installations and manage job timelines.
• Act as the in-between person between customers and installers.
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during installations.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Relevant experience in construction or working with contractors is highly desirable.
• Experience in problem-solving and customer service.
• Strong organizational skills.
• Excellent communication skills, with proficiency in English.
• Familiarity with spreadsheets and general computer software.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in construction project management.
• Experience with Airtable and Shopify.

Personality:

• Proactive and confident in taking initiative.
• Detail-oriented.
• Inquisitive and asks questions.
• Enjoys improving processes and solving problems.
• Works well with others and enjoys collaboration.
• Engaged and wants to be involved in the company.
• Adaptable and comfortable with change.

Software & Tools:

• Airtable
• Shopify
• Spreadsheets (e.g., Excel)

Schedule:

Monday to Friday
8 AM to 5 PM Central Time (with flexibility for lunch and appointments)
No weekends, except for occasional urgent issue resolution.

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.
• Full-time remote opportunity.

cerebre is on a mission to build the data foundation of the physical world. We offer a live intelligence map of a facilities – built from schematics to power AI. Often called the “brain” of the digital twin, cerebre helps engineers, data scientists, and business teams understand data within the context of the plant.

We collaborate with the world’s largest companies and most innovative partners who are transforming the industrial sector.

cerebre is a global team of engineers, scientists, innovators, and explorers united by a mission to help the world’s largest manufacturing facilities build and use intelligence.

Our development team is made up of world-class engineers who design and deliver novel solutions. This is an opportunity to join a market-leading team that is changing how the industrial world works.

If you love building and creating value in the “white space,” if you thrive with the freedom and flexibility to think outside the box, if you are passionate about working with critical thinkers who challenge the status quo, and if you aspire to work in a fast-paced environment – we would love to meet you!

We believe flexibility drives creativity and that our team should live and work where we can be our best selves. We’re 100% remote and offer a competitive time-off package to ensure time for rest and recharge.

About The Role

As the Senior Project Manager, you will be accountable for the successful delivery of all ongoing implementations of Cerebre technology from pilot through sustainment.

If you need hand-held and a mature project management office set of guidelines to be effective, this isn't the right role for you. If you're the person who builds those things because the work demanded it, keep reading.

Location:
Remote, with strong preference for candidates based in Houston, TX; open to CST/EST time zones

You will be responsible for

Leading end-to-end project scoping, planning, and handoff of deliverables.
Owning project scope, schedule, budget, quality, customer outcomes, and value realization.
Collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure desired outcomes.
Building trusted relationships with customers and leading clear communication through multiple levels of stakeholder management.
Identifying and managing risks, dependencies, scope creep and scope changes through a governed process.
Building the playbook for how Cerebre executes across all delivery functions now and into the future.

Required Skills

A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
5+ years running software, consulting or technology implementation projects, ideally in enterprise or industrial settings
Demonstrated ownership of a full project lifecycle: scoping, planning, execution, delivery. Not just coordination or status reporting
Direct customer-facing experience, including setting expectations, managing escalations, and pushing back on requests when needed
Strong risk and scope management. You can point to specific times you caught a scope change or a slipping dependency early and what you did about it
Comfortable working with engineers on technical detail. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand broadly how APIs, data pipelines, and integration work well enough to ask good questions and spot bad assumptions
Experience building or improving delivery processes, not just following them
Excellent written and verbal communication. Fluent English, C1 or better
Proficiency with project management tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent)
U.S. based or overlap with U.S. business hours
Willingness to travel up to 25% as required.

Preferred Skills

Experience in industrial sectors: oil and gas, chemicals, power, manufacturing, utilities, or life sciences
Familiarity with engineering documentation and plant data (P&IDs, asset registers, tag hierarchies) or OT systems like SCADA, MES, or historians

Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, ensuring contract deliverables, timelines, and project expectations are met.

Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.

Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.

Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.

This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.

Introduction

We are looking for a Project Manager
to join our Market Area North and Central America Project Delivery team
. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the execution of major customer contracts involving the design, retrofit, manufacturing, and installation of equipment and systems. You will ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual commitments, contributing to customer success and profitable business growth.

You will report to the Project Delivery Manager.

This role is based in Canada, the United States, or Mexico, with flexible working options available. Relocation is not provided for this role.

This role includes approximately 20% travel to customer sites and project locations across North America and other international destinations.

Team you will belong to

You will join a team of experienced project delivery professionals focused on executing complex capital equipment and systems projects for customers in the mining and aggregates industries. Our team plays a key role in ensuring successful project execution, customer satisfaction, and the delivery of Metso's industry-leading solutions, with a shared focus on safety, quality, collaboration, and operational excellence.

We collaborate closely with customers, engineering teams, procurement specialists, manufacturing facilities, field service personnel, subcontractors, and business stakeholders. Our team is based across North and Central America, and our ways of working emphasize open and honest communication, customer focus, accountability, and getting things done together.

What You'll Do

Lead the execution of major customer contracts from project kickoff through final closeout.
Establish project plans, budgets, schedules, and cash flow forecasts while monitoring performance and initiating corrective actions when required.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and field execution activities to ensure successful project delivery.
Review drawings, specifications, and requisitions to ensure compliance with contract requirements and project objectives.
Resolve technical, commercial, client, subcontractor, and cross-functional project issues.
Participate in the selection and management of subcontractors and major equipment suppliers.
Manage field activities, staffing requirements, and site coordination while promoting a strong safety culture.
Build trusted customer relationships, identify opportunities to address customer challenges, and support the delivery of value-added technical solutions.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 5 years of project management experience in industrial, engineering, manufacturing, construction, or capital equipment environments.
Experience with engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction contracts, scheduling, quality management, and cost control.
Strong knowledge of contract administration, commercial terms, and project execution methodologies.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, international environment.
Mechanical and/or electrical aptitude with the ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.
Fluency in French and/or Spanish, SAP Project Module experience, and knowledge of engineering or regulatory standards such as CSA or NEMA are considered assets.

What's In It For You

At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You'll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.

We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:

Purpose-led work: Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.
Wellbeing: Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.
Rewards: Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
Flexibility: Hybrid working options to support balance and productivity.
Growth: Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.
Culture: A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.

When joining Metso in your location, you can also benefit from:

Competitive benefits plan
Healthy living rewards
Mental wellbeing services
Annual leave starting at 15 days per calendar year
Engagement surveys
Global incentive program tied to business and performance targets

Get in touch

Want to rise above the possible with us? Click "Apply now"
to submit your application.

For additional information, please contact Deidre Largent, Talent Acquisition Specialist at deidre.largent@metso.com.

Recruitment timeline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may begin interviews before the application deadline.

We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.

Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

This is a client-side Project Manager opportunity with a global data centre developer delivering projects at a scale and complexity well beyond typical commercial builds. The role sits within a billion-dollar precinct and forms part of a long-term delivery program rather than a one-off project.

The position is predominantly site-based in Melbourne's western suburbs and reports directly to a Project Director. This is a delivery role, not an advisory or design-led position. The project is now at the fit-out stage and is heavy services-orientated. You will be working at the coalface of the project, supporting day-to-day delivery across program inputs, contractor and consultant coordination, sequencing, issue resolution and site-based decision-making for a highly technical fit-out.

This project requires people who have been embedded on complex live builds and understand how projects actually move on-site. Experience must come from environments such as data centres, hospitals, critical infrastructure, automation-led facilities, laboratories or similarly complex projects where service integration, commissioning and coordination are central to delivery. Candidates from architecture, design-only or advisory backgrounds without live construction delivery experience will not be suited.

The team works in a practical, delivery-led way and has built strong camaraderie on-site. The company has a genuinely good culture, with an approachable leadership team and people who work closely together to keep delivery moving. People are expected to take ownership, communicate clearly and stay close to the details. This is not a role for someone looking to manage from a distance or operate primarily from an office environment.

This role would suit a construction Senior Project Engineer, Senior Project Coordinator or a delivery-focused Project Manager who has worked on large, technically complex projects and is ready to step into a client-side role while remaining heavily involved in construction.

The role is site-based but flexible. There is scope to work from home one day per week, or from the inner-CBD head office one day per week, when appropriate. The expectation, however, is that the right person wants to be on-site and engaged with the project.

The salary for this role is up to a $240k package plus annual bonus, depending on experience.

to lead the successful execution of customer projects within our services organization. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, ensuring safe, profitable, and on-time delivery while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction.

As the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution, you will coordinate cross-functional teams, oversee project performance, manage risks, and drive operational excellence from project initiation through closeout.

Project Leadership & Execution

Lead cross-functional project teams, including engineering, planning, procurement, technical support, and field service resources.

Coordinate project kickoff meetings internally and with customers when required.

Manage third-party vendors and partners involved in project delivery.

Financial & Contract Management

Customer-focused mindset with excellent communication skills

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.

At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You'll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.

Description -

The Project Manager (PM) for Managed Service Delivery (MSD) applies advanced subject‑matter expertise to lead highly complex, multi-tower transitions and deployments across Managed Print Services (MPS). This role ensures seamless planning, execution, and governance of customer programs leveraging HP’s enterprise methodologies, service frameworks, and operational best practices.

HP delivers end-to-end solutions across the full MSD lifecycle—Define, Design, Deploy, Monitor, Manage, and Support phases—ensuring proactive experiences, optimized environments, and measurable business outcomes.

PMs are regarded as organizational leaders who frequently shape new ideas, influence process improvements, and represent HP to senior customer stakeholders. Their primary responsibility is leading the Deploy phase of the MSD lifecycle, ensuring that all aspects of deployment are executed seamlessly and in alignment with HP’s methodologies. They apply independent judgment within broadly defined policies to resolve complex issues involving technical, operational, financial, and organizational elements.

Job Summary

The PM leads the end‑to‑end deployment and transition of managed print environments, ensuring alignment to contractual scope, timeline, budget, and quality expectations. They act as the primary customer-facing leader during implementation and drive coordination across all functions to achieve contractual outcomes.

The PM applies advanced project management expertise, drives strategic alignment, and ensures accountability across HP and customer organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Deployment Leadership

Ownership of the Deployment phase for MPS programs, ensuring execution aligns with HP’s Deploy lifecycle.
Coordinate multi-functional, multivendor teams across print fleet management, software, analytics, and monitoring services.
Implement contractual and technical aspects to deploy all Managed Service Delivery towers, ensuring readiness for transition to steady-state.
Oversee the execution of the scope of work, including preparing cost estimates, managing schedules, driving DAIR documentation, and coordinating operational handover plans.
Apply HP methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid), PMP best practices, and HP service lifecycle (Define–Design–Deploy–Manage).
Manage complex portfolios affecting multiple customer divisions and multi-region deployments.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Represent HP expertise to customers and external partners.
Build and strengthen C‑level and director‑level relationships, providing thought leadership across all service towers.
Represent HP across all services towers, providing thought leadership and consultative guidance.
Act as a trusted advisor guiding customers through strategic changes in their environments.

Develop and manage program governance models, including steering committees, PMO structures, quality controls, DAIR logs, communication plans, and operational handover frameworks.
Anticipate challenges, assess and report on risk throughout the program, lead development and implementation of mitigation strategies.
Ensure contractual compliance across multiple towers, including SLAs, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the creation of new methods, templates, and policies.

Financial & Commercial Accountability

Own budgets across multi‑tower programs; track financial performance and forecasting.
Provide accurate forecasting.
Identify incremental cross-service opportunities that drive customer value and HP growth.

Lead diverse cross-functional teams (often >20 resources), including technical consultants, project coordinators, and external partners.
Mentor and develop project managers and tower leads.
Build productive internal/external working relationships across HP and with partner ecosystems.
Set expectations for delivery excellence and adherence to HP methodologies.

Manage programs with high risk, significant contractual complexity, and multi‑tower dependencies.
Leads projects with aggressive timelines and enterprise-scale business impact.
Participates in cross‑organizational initiatives and drives continuous improvement across Managed Service Delivery.

Four‑year or Graduate Degree in Business, Project Management—or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience in project management
Experience deploying tangible assets
Experience managing order placements, site coordination and logistics
Advanced Excel skills
Experience managing external customers

PMP
PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum certifications
Six Sigma or process improvement certifications

Expert command of HP Services operational policies, processes, and methodologies.
Deep fluency across Managed Service Delivery principles, including remote monitoring, analytics, and proactive management models.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
Ability to resolve complex issues across multiple technical domains.
Skilled in financial governance, contractual compliance, and multi‑tower integration.

Risk Management & Mitigation
Project Scoping, Planning, and Scheduling
Financial Governance & Forecasting
Microsoft Project & Project Documentation
Smartsheet
Excel
Change Management & Process Improvement
Business Operations, Business Development, CRM

Effective Communication
Customer Centricity
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We're hiring a People Project Manager
to join our HR PMO
and help deliver an ambitious portfolio of HR programs, products, and initiatives as we scale globally.

This is not a business-as-usual project management role
. We're a hypergrowth company building at speed, and our HR team is building alongside it. We're looking for someone who gets genuine energy from bringing order to chaos, creating structure where there isn't any yet, and getting important things shipped.

Hypergrowth, for real. Things move fast, priorities evolve, and there's always something meaningful to jump into. If you love pace, variety, and figuring things out as you go, you'll have a huge canvas here.
A chance to build. Our HR PMO is taking shape within a hugely ambitious HR team. You'll help create the workflows, rhythms, and tools we need to build a world-class function at scale.

Global from day one. Work across our distributed HR team and with stakeholders around the world.

Create order from chaos: Turn fast-moving, ambiguous problems into clear plans and outcomes
Are relentlessly organized: Stay ahead of details, dependencies, decisions, and follow-ups
Love pace: Move quickly, adapt as things change, and keep momentum high
Build great workflows: Find simpler, smarter, more scalable ways to get things done
Collaborate brilliantly: Bring stakeholders together and create clarity across teams
Think and do: Build the plan, then roll up your sleeves to get it over the line

You'll Help Drive

HR projects: Manage programs and initiatives across our global HR roadmap
Planning & delivery: Build plans, milestones, workstreams, and clear ownership
Cross-functional execution: Coordinate across HR, Finance, Legal, IT, and other teams
Project governance: Drive decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned
Better ways of working: Build repeatable workflows and tools that help HR execute at scale

We're Looking For Someone Who

3+ years of experience: Project or program management in a fast-moving, high-growth organization
Is an excellent project manager: Can independently drive complex, multi-stakeholder projects from start to finish
Is hyper-organized: Exceptional attention to detail and strong systems for managing work
Builds, not just operates: Gets excited by creating something new rather than maintaining business as usual
Manages stakeholders well: Creates alignment and accountability without relying on authority
Communicates exceptionally: Produces crisp plans, updates, and documentation

Location

, working across our distributed HR organization and with stakeholders around the world.

jobs.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

We are thrilled to announce an opening for an Operations Program Manager to join our dynamic VGOV Aviation team in Duluth, GA!

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) leads multi-functional production and aftermarket program teams and acts as the single point of accountability. They are a critical bridge between engineering, operations, and the business area to ensure the seamless transition of innovative products from concept through launch and sustainment. They focus on delivering world-class, high-visibility products on time, at scale, and of the highest quality. This role is a unique and rewarding position, combining aspects of production manufacturing, product engineering, depot repair, material control, and program management. Qualified candidates who are results driven, problem solvers, good communicators, and work well in a team-oriented environment should apply.

The day-to-day

You will apply your excellent leadership skills and your operations, engineering, and supply chain knowledge. You will ensure the cross-functional team meets business objectives and improves processes continuously. Your core responsibilities will consist of the following:

Cross functional leadership: Provides day-to-day direction to a multi-functional team including representatives from manufacturing, test engineering, sourcing, production planning, and quality assurance.
Leads and directs regular core team meetings while attending and reporting at executive program business reviews. Translates product line forecasts into an operational build plan. Manages schedule and product updates or adjustments. Plans labor forecasting and manufacturing capacity. Completes essential performance metrics.
On Time Delivery: Ensure we are building/delivering and repairing/returning to our contractual commitments on our customer’s behalf.
Budget Execution: Responsible for defined budgets that must be well controlled to ensure program profitability.
Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to apply lean methodologies to our production manufacturing and repair stations aimed at improving throughput, cost, and quality that are inclusive of up and downstream operations.
Product Lifecycle Management: Responsible for overseeing the entire PLM including production readiness, production execution, product updates & engineering change orders, obsolescence management, and aftermarket sustainment.

What You'll Need

4+ of experience in roles such as program management, operations management, or engineering (a mix of these in a hardware focused environment is highly preferred).

jobs.description:
***This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and 1 days per week at our Oakland Headquarters based on business need.

Department Overview:

The IT Third-Party Strategy and Operations (TPSO) team, within the Office of the CIO (OCIO), provides the governance, structure, and operational discipline that enable effective management of IT third-party ecosystem. TPSO drives strategic, operational, and financial oversight across contracts, vendors, labor programs, and portfolio data, ensuring consistent standards, informed decision-making, and optimized spend. Through cross-functional partnership with sourcing, finance, architecture, and delivery teams, TPSO establishes enterprise controls, enhances transparency, and supports the reliable delivery of IT services that power the business.

Position Summary:

This role serves as a central integration point for the IT Third-Party Strategy and Operations leadership team, helping translate priorities into clear plans and ensuring coordinated execution across multiple functional areas. The position partners closely with other OCIO teams, sourcing, finance, architecture, and delivery organizations to align stakeholders, manage interdependencies, and maintain an effective operating cadence that drives program outcomes. With a focus on IT third-party management, the role helps coordinate work across contract governance, vendor management, labor programs, and financial oversight activities to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment with enterprise standards. This includes tracking progress across initiatives, surfacing risks and decisions, and ensuring dependencies are actively managed across internal teams and external partners. The role also supports program-level reporting and leader-ready communications, enabling informed decision-making and visibility into performance, financials, and delivery outcomes. Operating with a high degree of autonomy and influence, this position works across organizational boundaries to connect strategy to execution and ensure complex third-party initiatives remain aligned, well-governed, and on track.

Leads complex, cross-functional initiatives that support IT third-party strategy execution, ensuring alignment across contract governance, vendor management, labor programs, and financial oversight activities.
Serves as a central coordination point across OCIO, sourcing, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and external partners, managing interdependencies and driving progress to achieve program objectives.
Establishes and maintains operating cadence, including tracking milestones, risks, decisions, and action items to ensure consistent execution and accountability across multiple workstreams.
Develops and maintains strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners, supporting effective collaboration and alignment across the third-party ecosystem.
Monitors program performance, including financials, budgets, and key metrics, and provides clear, data-driven insights into variances, risks, and opportunities.
Communicates program status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, including preparing concise, executive-ready updates and materials.
Identifies opportunities to improve processes, governance, and operating models, including recommending enhancements to third-party management practices and standards.

jobs.title: Subcontracts Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Job Description

Primary program POC with management responsibility and overall cost/schedule/technical accountability for a single major/critical subcontract, or portfolio of large program subcontracts performance, risk management and tracking. Plan, organize, direct, and control significant program subcontract management activities in support of an SMS proposal or program. Ensure supplier execution of all subcontract requirements for cost, schedule, technical, and mission assurance. Additionally, maintain positive internal and external relations with the BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) customer, the program team, and the supplier(s).

The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state-of-the-art manufacturing and test operations and top-notch facilities management.

The Integrated Supply Chain team has a direct impact on program success, acting as a critical chain that links the end-to-end material flow together. Our organization helps propel us forward and achieve true mission partnership.

What You’ll Do

Responsible for overall leadership and management of a single program subcontract or a portfolio of program subcontracts, with clear lines of authority defined at the program level. Primary Program POC to all Program subcontract stakeholders with responsibility for subcontract cost, schedule, technical, quality, and all deliverables going to/from subcontractor(s).
Participate in proposal preparation activities in support of new business capture opportunities with existing and/or new subcontractors, customers, and programs. Coordinate compilation of supplier RFP packages to align to customer proposal scope, timelines, and objectives. Coordinate SME inputs to technical evaluations of complex subcontractor proposals, assessing realism, reasonableness, and completeness.
May lead development of Program Subcontract Management Plan (PSMP).
Lead the program Subcontract Management Team (SMT) and aligns with the program to ensure the SMT is staffed with appropriate skill levels and that internal work is being accomplished according to plan in support of the subcontract management plan.
Ensure program mission requirements, purposes, objectives, and expectations are communicated and flowed to the subcontractor(s). Responsible for development and execution of subcontract: management plan, scope of work, technical requirements, mission assurance requirements, milestones, SDRLs and any other subcontract(s) deliverables necessary.
Responsible for all subcontract(s) deliverables to the various program levels, as applicable.
Program level budgetary authority for subcontract execution including profit/loss, labor budget, management reserve, and all aspects of oversight and management of the subcontract(s).
Responsible for subcontract cost tracking, Earned Value (EV) and EAC budget, variance tracking and reporting requirements, including management, and monitoring timely supplier financial reporting.
Ensure visibility and communication of subcontract technical, quality assurance, financial, schedule, and compliance to Program reporting requirements.
Responsible for subcontract schedule and program level schedule margin specific to the subcontract(s). Ensure supplier IMS is integrated into the Program level IMS.
Manage the subcontract(s) risks including subcontract(s) cost, schedule, technical and quality risks. Responsible for deconflicting resource and schedule conflicts at subcontractor(s) location. Responsibility and know-how to leverage program and SMS team in achieving efficient conflict resolution.
Responsible for subcontract(s) change control and management. Support change proposal efforts for subcontract(s) including pre-coordination with subcontractor(s) to establish expectations. Lead internal evaluation of subcontractor(s) change proposals and development of negotiation plans
In partnership with the Subcontract Manager (SMS’ empowered official for the subcontract), act as the principal interface with the subcontractor on all subcontract related subjects and perform as a liaison between subcontractor, Program, and other stakeholders as needed.
Work closely with and assist Subcontract Manager to ensure Subcontract is maintained current and meets Program requirements. Establish SMS programmatic negotiation position and support subcontract negotiations.
Work closely with Program Management and customer to communicate subcontractor progress, resolve issues and concerns, and identify and manage subcontractor risk.
Coordinate the participants, schedule, logistics, and success criteria and chair subcontractor program status, business, design, manufacturing, test and pre-ship reviews, including inclusion of Customer participation.
May develop and manage a complete Subcontractor Performance system to tie past performance, current requirements, and subcontract documentation and management into predictive subcontractor performance model.
Ensure that all business is conducted using the highest ethical standards and in compliance with all applicable laws, statutes, and regulations.
Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.
Perform other duties as necessary.

On-Site Work Environment:

This position requires regular in-person engagement by working

on-site five days

each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in an office environment, laboratory, cleanroom, or production floor.

Short Term Incentive:

Subject to business performance and recommendations of management, this role may be eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

BS/BA in related field plus 10 or more years related experience.
Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
A current, active Top Secret/SCI security clearance is required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI Polygraph.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $134640 - $228888

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, Space & Mission Systems is a leading provider of national defense and civil space applications, advanced remote sensing, scientific and tactical systems for government and commercial customers. We continually pioneer ways to innovate spacecraft, mission payloads, optical systems, and other defense and civil capabilities. Powered by endlessly curious people with an unwavering mission focus, we continually discover ways to enable our customers to perform beyond expectation and protect what matters most.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Multiple positions may be available on this opening.

Job Description

This role is based in Nashville, TN. This role will require relocation to Nashville, TN if you do not reside in the region.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished Lead Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) and Server Operations programs across parts of North America.

This Lead Principal TPM will provide strategic and operational program leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix support, and automation across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish scalable program mechanisms that enable rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, workforce effectiveness, and technical rigor. This leader will partner across engineering and operations teams, standardize execution across multiple sites, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and data-driven program management.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions while improving the systems, tools, and operating rhythms that support reliable cloud infrastructure at scale.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong program leader with a proven track record of driving large-scale infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation programs through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations execution across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide program leadership for Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations initiatives across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix operations, and operational automation.
Develop and execute scalable program frameworks capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple sites and cross-functional teams.
Lead complex, geographically distributed programs that improve operational performance, safety, security, availability, and service quality across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, strengthening program governance, and implementing best practices across regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, scripting, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and manual effort.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing program risk, dependencies, and execution gaps.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Senior technical program management experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, software development, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience driving large, geographically distributed programs across multiple teams, sites, and operational functions.
Demonstrated success scaling operational systems, program mechanisms, and execution models within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, distributed systems, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, networking, storage, compute, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, scripting, process engineering, and scalable program models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities, operational analytics, Jira, Confluence, and related program tooling to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, technical judgment, program execution, and written and verbal communication.
Strong executive presence with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering and operations teams in collaborative, agile environments while driving clarity, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Manager for the Technical Program Management (TPM) of Digital Twin program in Supply Chain. The TPM for Digital Twin will partner closely with Digital Twin Leadership, Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, other cross-functional capability teams and external partners to deliver Digital Twin applications through global solutions. The role will be accountable for product delivery (BuildOps) governance and execution oversight throughout the product lifecycle from ideation and discovery through implementation and support.

This leader will bring strong delivery mindset and will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver Digital Twin capabilities across PepsiCo facilities globally including but not limited to Manufacturing plants, warehouses, and yards.

Responsibilities

Lead Global BuildOps (project execution and delivery) with cross-functional mission-based teams across IT/OT, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Sector IT
Drive end-to-end technical program management from initial conception, through design and development, to delivery of tested, useable prototypes and final applications
Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Product, engineering, business, design, architecture and external partners) to identify scope, constraints, dependencies, risks, and timelines across programs
Establish a consistent and scalable delivery methodology with all stakeholders
Lead the complex transformation program by guiding partners on PepsiCo-specific tools, frameworks, and processes related to Project Planning and DevSecOps Delivery
Proactively identify technical, procedural, legal, logistical, budget, and communications challenges and partner with leads to drive creative solutions to resolve issues and mitigate risks
Coordinate communications across internal and external teams, including upwards communication to team leadership
Communicate frequently with program leadership to shape and deliver on the product roadmap, and nimbly switch between strategic and tactical initiatives to achieve technical and business objectives within the schedule and budget
Create detailed Project Plans through PI Planning sessions and provide day-to-day governance to execute the project based on that plan
Partner with strategic vendors and system integrators to deliver against roadmap with measurable milestones, quality standards, and cost discipline
Provide timely reporting and necessary escalations to leadership teams and present in regular reporting cadences including BuildOps Reviews, ART syncs and SteerCo meetings
Establish guidelines and conduct stage gates to ensure project milestones are exited with acceptable quality standards, applicable security protocols and functional completion of the digital application

Compensation & Benefits:

The expected compensation range for this position is between $140,100 - $234,850.
Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Supply Chain, Data/Analytics, or a comparable field.

Experience:

The ideal Technical Program Manager (TPM) will have 8-10 years of work experience, with 3-5 years of experience as Delivery Lead / Technical Program Manager leading delivery of complex digital transformation projects
They will be highly quantitative, have great judgment, able to connect the dots across workstreams, identify critical program dependencies, and have a strong track record of delivery
They will have a pragmatic outlook and iterative approach to building technical solutions including ability to simplify and get things done with a demonstrated track record of working effectively with external and internal teams
They will dive deep to understand the program including the infrastructure, dataset dependencies for local requirements for feature/application deployments, and integration testing requirements before deployment
They will bring exceptional business relationship skills including the ability to discover the true requirements underlying feature requests, recommend alternative technical and business approaches, and lead engineering efforts to meet aggressive timelines with optimal solutions
Their strong experience in project delivery using SAFe Agile methodology and familiarity with other delivery models including waterfall is key
They will have good understanding of SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) models and a track record of shipping software efficiently along with the ability to recognize the difference between building software and shipping software
They will have strong experience in managing project timelines, budgets and status reports, navigating Change Approval Boards and associated processes. They must be proficient in Azure DevOps (ADO) Boards/Backlogs/Queries along with expertise in entire Microsoft Office 365 suite
They have a proven track record of program delivery for large, cross-functional, projects
They have deep hands-on technical expertise, and excellent verbal and written communication skills
They are familiar with Supply Chain business processes, systems and personas

Leadership:

Executive influence and ability to align business and technology stakeholders globally.
Strong delivery leadership (Product Backlog management, PI Planning, delivery milestones, Stage Gates, Deployment, Hypercare, Reporting & Governance).
Ability to lead high-performing multidisciplinary teams and vendors with high accountability.

Differentiating Qualities:

Demonstrate perseverance and resilience in the pursuit of goals. Confront and work to resolve tough issues. Exhibit a “can-do” attitude and a willingness to take on significant challenges
Demonstrate a sense of passion, enjoyment, and pride in their work. Demonstrate a positive attitude in the workplace. Embrace and adapt well to change. Create a work environment that makes work rewarding and enjoyable
Build convincing, persuasive, and logical storyboards. Have a strong executive presence. Able to communicate effectively and succinctly, both verbally and on paper
Analyze complex problems quickly to find actionable, pragmatic solutions. See connections in data, events, trends, etc. Consistently work based on the right priorities
